newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar little changed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar little changed in quiet trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished little changed on Thursday in quiet trade as foreign equity funds entered the island more slowly than expected, dealers said.
The rate finished at T$27.492 against Wednesday's T$27.491 close. Turnover was US$140 million.
The market had expected strong demand for the local unit following the government's approval of nearly US$1 billion in foreign funds to enter the stock market.
"The funds may come in slowly over the next few months, which won't push the Taiwan dollar too high," said one dealer.
The Securities and Exchange Commission's approvals of US$977 million in foreign equity investments are valid for six months.
Initial resistance for the local unit was seen at T$27.480. -- Joyce Liu (2-5080815)
